notes:
Highlights:
- Smarter imports: archives you already own are recognized - even when renamed - and skipped instead of creating duplicates. Imported releases appear in your library and search results immediately.
- Dependable backups: automatic snapshots are always consistent and restore cleanly, and manual backups save the complete backup set to your chosen location.
- Smoother 3D previews: preview generation is faster to start, resilient to damaged files, and no longer gets stuck on unreadable ones.
- Polished experience: reliable startup and first-run flow, faster browsing of large archives, and general stability and security hardening throughout.
